definitions.full: H3626. Kol -chozeh כָּלחֹֿזֶה proper name, masculine 1. father of one of the builders, Shallun Neh 3:15 . 2 a name in Judah Neh 11:5 (relation to 1 unknown). כִּלָּיוֺן כְּלִי, , etc., see below I. כלה . כִּלְיָה see below II. כלה .

occurrences.englishText: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah repaired the spring gate. He built it, and covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even to the stairs that go down from David’s city.
and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
